questions.question: The measurement usually about 1°F higher than oral temperature is:

choices.B: It prevents heat from reaching the skin

questions.miniGuide: Lower skin blood flow keeps more heat in deep tissues and reduces loss to the environment.

choices.B: Secretory coils remove all electrolytes before secretion
choices.C: Sweat glands add protein to the duct fluid

choices.B: Sweat becomes more concentrated with sodium
choices.C: Sweating begins more effectively and can increase greatly

choices.C: It increases sodium secretion into sweat

choices.B: It increases heat loss before heat production
choices.C: It provides anticipatory protection against hypothermia
choices.D: It eliminates the need for vasoconstriction

choices.B: Insulin release → vasodilation → lower hypothalamic set point
choices.C: Calcitonin release → shivering → higher skin temperature

choices.C: The set point returns toward normal while core temperature remains high
